title: All-hands Sept 2026 - Talking points (draft)
content:
All-hands - Sept 2026 (working draft)
Owner: Oliver Kim - Internal comms / head of comms (notes to self)
Collaborators: Maya (product), Samira (growth), Jordan (engineering)
Status: draft - will iterate after leadership sync 2026-09-12

Goal: concise 10-12 minute update for company + 5-10 min Q&A. Focus: what shipped, what customers are seeing, runway/ops updates, and 3 things for org to rally around.

Topline (1 sentence):
- Strong quarter: uptime and latency improvements in Production, Dedicated capacity adoption up 40% quarter-over-quarter, and early Private deployments in 2 regulated customers - building towards more predictable unit economics.

Suggested talking points (order + time allotment):
1) Quick welcome + gratitude (30s)
- Quick thanks to infra/serving-runtime/SRE for a tough month of incidents and steady fixes.

2) Product & roadmap highlights (3 min)
- Hosted API: streaming + function-calling improvements rolled out to GA - saw 12% decrease in median tail latency for chat workloads after kernel selection changes.
- Redwood Optimize beta: pilot with 8 customers showing 20-35% cost savings via batching + KV cache tuning.
- Dedicated: new GPU reservation UI now in Console - simplifies autoscale policies (internal metric: MRR from Dedicated up 25% QoQ).
- Private: completed first on-prem PoC with Acme Health (HIPAA) - next step is security review and docs for broader rollout.

3) Reliability & incidents (2 min)
- Brief recap of Sept 2 incident: root cause = autoscaler edge-case + subnet exhaustion in eu-west-1; mitigations: autoscaler patch landed, improved capacity fallbacks, added multi-region routing for critical routes.
- Current status: SLA attainment back to target; postmortem published (link in Confluence).

4) Business signals (1 min)
- Usage growth: host API token growth +35% YoY; embedding units steady with new search apps.
- Sales: two mid-market deals converting to Dedicated contracts next quarter.

5) People & hiring (30s)
- Hiring: ramping SRE and platform-engineering; prioritize infra automation roles.
- Reminder: referrals open - bonus updated in HR portal.

6) 3 things to rally around (30s)
- Observable quality: own metrics and dashboards for token costs and latency on your team routes.
- Canary-first rollouts: use the rollout console and feature flags for risky changes.
- Customer-first debugging: when an issue hits, page the on-call and include a tiny reproduction prompt and trace id.

7) Close + Q&A (remaining time)

Planned slide flow (speaker notes):
- Slide 1: Title + TL;DR bullets (1 line each)
- Slide 2: Product highlights (one bubble per product area)
- Slide 3: Reliability timeline (incident -> fix -> current metrics)
- Slide 4: Customer / sales wins (quotes and logos, anonymized if needed)
- Slide 5: Hiring & org asks
- Slide 6: 3 rallying asks + CTA (link to follow-up doc)

Draft Q&A (prep answers) - anticipate these: 
Q: Are we extending credits for free-tier customers?
A: No immediate change; product team evaluating longer-term trials tied to usage patterns. If you see an urgent customer ask, route to growth (samira@).

Q: Are there price changes coming for hosted API?
A: No immediate pricing changes. We continue to focus on unit economics via Optimize (better batching/compact profiles) rather than list price changes. Any pricing discussion will be communicated in advance with details.

Q: What does the Acme Health PoC mean for Private? Is this GA?
A: It is a successful PoC but not GA. We have to complete compliance docs and an internal checklist (security review, runbook, on-prem install guide) before public availability. Targeting late Q4 for first general availability, contingent on docs and support model.

Q: What are we doing to avoid future autoscaler-related incidents?
A: Short term: autoscaler patch + fallback routing rules. Medium term: rewrite of autoscaler to better model capacity + region-aware allocation; this is an engineering priority with a dedicated sprint (ENG-3245).

Notes to self / unresolved items (action items):
- [ ] Confirm final metrics (median/tail latencies, Dedicated MRR) with Jordan by 09/12 EOD. (Jordan: please add the numbers + three bullet talking points)
- [ ] Design check: slides approved by Design (Maya) - need final hero graphic by 09/13.
- [ ] Legal review for Acme Health quote - Samira to follow up with Legal.
- [ ] Post-all-hands follow-up doc: public summary + internal FAQ (link to Confluence draft).

Tone notes: keep upbeat but candid on incidents; avoid technical jargon for company-level summary; call out wins for infra and SRE explicitly.

Slack channels / links to include on slide 6: #all-hands, #status, #product-updates
Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/inference/announcements/ah-sept-2026 (draft)
Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood/inference/incidents/2026-09-02-autoscaler
Jira: ENG-3245 (autoscaler follow-up)
GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/88 (release notes draft)

"Notes to self" quick checklist before rehearsal:
- get final metrics from ENG (Jordan)
- 2 rehearsal runs with CEO + CTO
- finalize script for Q&A answers (Maya + Samira)

-----
Version history (working):
- 2026-09-10: initial draft
- 2026-09-12: updated with incident mitigations + added Q&A

End of draft.
